method: Each simulate-principal-policy ran with ONE --resource-arns in its OWN invocation. Two or more ARNs in a single call flip the held ones to implicitDeny, which would have corrupted BOTH readings here -- the deny would be the instrument and the allow would be gone.
why_the_positive_control_matters: An implicitDeny alone cannot distinguish 'the grant was removed' from 'the simulation could not see a grant'. The kept ARN reading allowed, in a separate invocation against the same principal and action, is what shows the instrument still discriminates -- so the bearer's implicitDeny is about the world. Pre-cut the issuer read BOTH as allowed, which is the other end of the same control.
version_ceiling_note: The policy now has 5 versions (v1-v5) and the AWS limit is 5. This apply reached the ceiling: a FURTHER version of this policy needs a prune first. Recorded here because the next applier of this root will meet it, not because it affects this act.
